claims.evidence: No capacity or weight stamp is legible on either cylinder's neck/collar in any photo; the two cylinders shown differ in color/brand (yellow unbranded vs blue BERADISCO), so even the single description is ambiguous as to which item this refers to.

risks.risk: No regulator/valve fitted — only a plug/nut visible on both cylinders, so it may be sold bare.
risks.proof: Close-up photo showing a proper LPG valve (with threads intact) screwed in, or explicit seller confirmation that only the cylinder body is sold.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cylinder body only, without valve/regulator

risks.risk: Capacity/weight rating (e.g. 12.5kg) cannot be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the stamped capacity/tare weight on the cylinder collar or neck.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common standard size until stamp is confirmed

risks.risk: Unknown whether cylinder currently holds any gas (empty vs full affects value and usability).
risks.proof: Weighing video/photo on a scale showing gross weight, or a fill-level check at a gas station.

risks.risk: Test/manufacture/expiry date stamp not visible — expired cylinders are often rejected for refill by gas stations in Nigeria.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamped test date ring on the cylinder neck.

risks.risk: Underside/base condition, dents, or corrosion not shown — could affect structural safety.
risks.proof: Photo of the cylinder base and underside.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming visible scuffs/rust extend underneath (worst case)

risks.risk: Valve threads could be damaged or leaking, not assessable from photos.
risks.proof: Video of a leak test (soapy water on valve under pressure) or a technician's inspection note.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a faulty/leaking valve

risks.risk: Two distinct cylinders (yellow and blue) are shown under one listing with one description, raising doubt about what exactly is being sold.
risks.proof: Seller to clarify and photograph each cylinder separately with its own capacity stamp if both are for sale.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single unit matching the lowest-value cylinder shown

proof_requests: Close-up of the capacity/tare weight stamp on each cylinder's neck/collar
Close-up of the test/expiry date stamp
Photo or video confirming whether a valve/regulator is included and functional
Weighing video to show current gas fill level
Clarification on whether one or both cylinders (yellow and blue) are part of this sale
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type as a cooking gas cylinder, so it can be priced at its worst case (no valve, unconfirmed capacity, possibly empty, unproven safety date) pending the listed proofs.
